messages.content: Check whether Specializing in Nodoguro Ginza Nakamata has a table for two on November 18, 2026 at 8:30 PM.

3) Nodoguro Nakamata — 2-chōme-15-15-1F Tsukiji, Higashi-Ginza
4) Sakananonakamata Ginza — 3-chōme-14-17 Ginza (Kobikiss GINZa 2F)
Or tell me the branch/area if it's a different one.

capabilities.name: ANSWER_PAGE_QUESTION
capabilities.purpose: Answer the current explicit follow-up about a displayed restaurant.
capabilities.inputSchema: no business fields; code binds the user question, outlet, source and current run
capabilities.resultMeaning: A short cited answer, bounded not-stated, or unverified result; never eligibility or inventory.
importantConstraints: Only an explicit pending user question permits this action; do not specify a venue, URL or question.

capabilities.name: ASK_USER
capabilities.purpose: Request a user clarification that is necessary or useful to proceed safely.
capabilities.inputSchema: question, optional relatedFields
capabilities.resultMeaning: The task waits for a new user message; no state constraint is changed.
importantConstraints: Do not claim a booking or availability result.

capabilities.name: SEARCH_RESTAURANTS
capabilities.purpose: Discover matching restaurant outlets.
capabilities.inputSchema: optional retrievalHint; the router binds authoritative intent
capabilities.resultMeaning: Returns RestaurantCandidate records only, without availability claims.
importantConstraints: Cannot modify, repeat, or loosen authoritative user constraints.

capabilities.name: INVESTIGATE_CANDIDATE_FACTS
capabilities.purpose: Read source-supported restaurant facts needed by the current request for known candidates.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateIds; the router binds candidates and authoritative request conditions
capabilities.resultMeaning: Returns candidate-associated source facts or an explicit unknown result; it never asserts availability.
importantConstraints: Only known candidates are valid; at most three candidates per bounded read; it does not itself claim a slot.

capabilities.name: CHECK_AVAILABILITY
capabilities.purpose: Read request-bound availability and any source-supported restaurant facts returned with it.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateIds; the router binds authoritative date, time window, and party size
capabilities.resultMeaning: Returns fresh AvailabilityOffer records associated with candidate IDs.
importantConstraints: Only known candidates are valid; schedule values are never Agent-supplied; at most three unchecked candidates per read batch.

capabilities.name: END_READ
capabilities.purpose: End a bounded read-only investigation when its recorded scope has no grounded result to present.
capabilities.inputSchema: no business fields; optional short decision summary is trajectory-only
capabilities.resultMeaning: Writes a scoped NO_VERIFIED_RESULT outcome from authoritative investigation records, never a global negative claim.
importantConstraints: Only code may allow this after actual investigation; it cannot hide an internal failure, pending refresh, or grounded candidate.

capabilities.name: PRESENT_RESULTS
capabilities.purpose: Pause a read-only selection session with candidates whose required facts and availability are grounded.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateIds; validator derives the required evidence from authoritative State
capabilities.resultMeaning: Writes an evidence-grounded result batch and waits for explicit user continuation; it does not select, authorize, or submit a booking.
importantConstraints: Every task-critical fact, including each HARD criterion and availability, must have current trusted evidence.

capabilities.name: SELECT_CANDIDATE
capabilities.purpose: Choose a discovered candidate and optionally its known offer for a possible booking proposal.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateId, optional offerId
capabilities.resultMeaning: Records the selection; it does not authorize or submit a booking.
importantConstraints: A selected offer must belong to the selected candidate.

capabilities.name: BOOK_RESERVATION
capabilities.purpose: Request a booking proposal for one selected fresh offer.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateId, offerId
capabilities.resultMeaning: Creates a deterministic ActionProposal and waits for valid user authorization.
importantConstraints: Cannot authorize, commit, or claim success.
